company.shortDescription: Soria Analytics provides an AI-native terminal for healthcare-focused investment research and financial analytics.
company.description: Soria Analytics provides an AI-native terminal for healthcare-focused investment research and financial analytics. The company operates a platform that aggregates and normalizes diverse public and commercial healthcare datasets, including insurance enrollment data, quality ratings, statutory filings, Medicaid data, and corporate filings. Its system uses artificial intelligence agents to transform unstructured and fragmented inputs into a unified sector intelligence layer and structured spreadsheets. The platform is designed to replace manual data collection and spreadsheet-based tracking commonly used by institutional investors and analysts. Users access predictive analytics, custom dashboards, real-time alerts, and research feeds through a central terminal interface, Model Context Protocol, APIs, or direct data warehouse synchronization. Soria Analytics focuses initially on healthcare investments while maintaining a general-purpose financial technology architecture.
